The '''Graculans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with large [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|youngling]] active on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]<ref name="Tethan" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' is set during the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> was familiar with the Graculans.<ref name="Tethan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Graculans were mentioned in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books. In one adventure path the reader may take in the book's story, the protagonist, a [[Tethan]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], encounters a pair of [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] sentries guarding the main gate of the Teth [[City/Legends|city]] [[Raidos]], with the youngling mentally comparing [[Unidentified Barabel sentry|one]] of the guards' set of teeth to those of a Graculan.<ref name="Tethan" />
